# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo)
> Agent-first AI coding context & zero-LLM-exposure secret migration Skill across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Windsurf, Cline, Kilo, Zed, OpenCode, Kimi Code, Qwen Code, Pi, and 75+ cataloged tools.

`agent-skills-setup` helps an existing coding agent migrate rules/instructions, Agent Skills, MCP server definitions, commands, agents, parked hooks, authored memory, and out-of-band `0600` `.env`/MCP secrets across tools or plain device-transfer folders without exposing raw secret values to LLM context (`--redact-secrets` available on request). No proprietary `.acb` archive engine, signing service, or background daemon is used.

- [Product Catalog Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/skills/agent-skills-setup/references/products.md): Progressive routing index for 90 profiles across 30 family references.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo/main/llms-full.txt): Extended architectural summary and safety invariants.
